# `dayofweek`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the day of the week for date/timestamp (1 = Sunday, 2 = Monday, ..., 7 = Saturday).

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
dayofweek(date)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- dayofweek, example 1
> SELECT dayofweek('2009-07-30');
5
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.3.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
